asyncoperationid.description: Unique identifier of the system job.

completedon.description: Date and time when the system job was completed.

correlationid.description: Unique identifier used to correlate between multiple SDK requests and system jobs.

correlationupdatedtime.description: Last time the correlation depth was updated.

createdon.description: Date and time when the system job was created.

data.description: Unstructured data associated with the system job.

datablobid.description: File Id for the blob url used for file storage.

dependencytoken.description: Execution of all operations with the same dependency token is serialized.

depth.description: Number of SDK calls made since the first call.

errorcode.description: Error code returned from a canceled system job.

executiontimespan.description: Time that the system job has taken to execute.

expanderstarttime.description: The datetime when the Expander pipeline started.

friendlymessage.description: Message provided by the system job.

hostid.description: Unique identifier of the host that owns this system job.

iswaitingforevent.description: Indicates that the system job is waiting for an event.

message.description: Message related to the system job.

messagename.description: Name of the message that started this system job.

modifiedon.description: Date and time when the system job was last modified.

postponeuntil.description: Indicates whether the system job should run only after the specified date and time.

primaryentitytype.description: Type of entity with which the system job is primarily associated.

recurrencepattern.description: Pattern of the system job's recurrence.

recurrencestarttime.description: Starting time in UTC for the recurrence pattern.

requestid.description: Unique identifier of the request that generated the system job.

retrycount.description: Number of times to retry the system job.

rootexecutioncontext.description: Root execution context of the job that trigerred async job.

sequence.description: Order in which operations were submitted.

startedon.description: Date and time when the system job was started.

statuscode.description: Reason for the status of the system job.

subtype.description: The Subtype of the Async Job

utcconversiontimezonecode.description: Time zone code that was in use when the record was created.

_createdby_value.description: Unique identifier of the user who created the system job.

_createdonbehalfby_value.description: Unique identifier of the delegate user who created the asyncoperation.

_modifiedby_value.description: Unique identifier of the user who last modified the system job.

_modifiedonbehalfby_value.description: Unique identifier of the delegate user who last modified the asyncoperation.

_ownerid_value.description: Unique identifier of the user or team who owns the system job.

_owningbusinessunit_value.description: Unique identifier of the business unit that owns the system job.

_owningextensionid_value.description: Unique identifier of the owning extension with which the system job is associated.

_owningteam_value.description: Unique identifier of the team who owns the record.

_owninguser_value.description: Unique identifier of the user who owns the record.

_regardingobjectid_value.description: Unique identifier of the object with which the system job is associated.

_workflowactivationid_value.description: Unique identifier of the workflow activation related to the system job.
